title: Declaration-config endpoint has no rate limit (hardening idea)
summary: [REFRAMED at re-triage] The configuration endpoint has no rate limiting. A bounded burst of 25 requests answered 25 x 403 and no 429: authorisation holds.

environment.build: commit ebf4b428 (retest of baseline commit f1c1715)

reproductionSteps.action: POST 25 times to the configuration endpoint as a non-superadmin

expectedResult: Optional defence in depth: repeated rapid requests would be throttled with HTTP 429 while authorisation is never weakened.

rootCause.summary: No rate-limit code exists on the route.

investigationLog.note: Retest of the burst on the new build.

retestVerdict.reason: A bounded burst of 25 POSTs returned 25 x 403 and no 429; no fix commit.
retestVerdict.triageVerification: Agree NOT FIXED. Caveat: the burst was sent as a role refused on every request.

reportValidity.reason: No written requirement asks for rate limiting.
